brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape approximately 16:9, preferably 1920x1080 PNG. This is a new original hand-drawn illustration with integrated typography, not a photograph.

Art direction: approved バスケまとめ style: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B broad diagonal dry-brush strokes, ivory text, confident rough ink and brush hatching, a few orange accents only on the basketball. Bold Japanese gothic headline, extremely clear at thumbnail size, few elements and generous spacing. No logos of any kind.

Subject: ONE real professional basketball player, Hayden Koval (ハイデン・コヴァル), selected at random from names in the supplied article. His official B.LEAGUE profile photo was visually inspected: https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/2728/2026-27/43437_03.png (profile https://www.bleague.jp/en/roster_detail/?PlayerID=43437).
Accurately reflect the observed appearance: very tall, lean athletic adult man, fair skin, short sandy/light brown hair parted loosely on his left and swept across the forehead toward his right, modest volume on top with neat short sides; long angular face with squared jaw and pronounced chin; straight prominent nose; light blue eyes with slightly narrowed lids; thin light eyebrows; wide mouth and distinct smile lines; completely clean-shaven; long neck and long arms. Do not depict the dark-haired bearded player in the style example. Use stylized ivory/black ink facial planes with recognizable hair, nose, eyes, jaw and chin, not photorealism, not a generic substitute.

Composition: player fills the LEFT 42 percent, from head to upper thighs, three-quarter front view, in a dynamic low-post pivot, knees bent and torso turning right while holding an orange basketball securely at chest/upper waist with both hands. Face clearly visible. Two anatomically coherent arms and two natural hands, fingers partly wrapping the ball, no extra fingers or limbs. Whole head, elbows, hands and ball comfortably inside canvas. Plain dark sleeveless basketball uniform with a subtle ivory edge, absolutely no letters, no numbers, no team badges, no sponsor marks. Lower thighs may naturally meet the bottom edge. A wide lime brush slash behind the figure conveys motion. Background is abstract, not a documented arena.

Text block on the RIGHT 53 percent, aligned left within that block, separated cleanly from figure. Top small ivory masthead, then lime date large, then largest ivory Japanese headline, then lime/ivory subheadline and smaller league names. Keep 6% outer safe margins, all text fully inside frame. Footer across bottom on a clear near-black strip, readable.
Text (verbatim, render ONLY these strings):
"バスケまとめ"
"11/21"
"試合結果"
"当日のEFF"
"B.ONE・B.NEXT"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

Source context: fixed article title is 11/21 試合結果・当日のEFF, date 2026-11-21, B.ONE and B.NEXT results plus position EFF tables; B.PREMIER had no games. The picture is an imagined basketball movement, not a recreation of a specific game. Do not put the selected player's name, individual scores, performance, appearance claims or a uniform number in the image. Do not add a score, rank, result, opponent, fantasy card points or any unsupported text. Do not copy the official photograph or use a photographic cutout. Clearly illustrated, strong brush texture but clean legible face and text.


ONE ALLOWED REVISION
Edit image 1, the generated basketball thumbnail. Image 2 is the official portrait of the SAME real athlete Hayden Koval, for likeness reference ONLY; never paste photographic pixels, uniform, logos or lettering from image 2.

Make ONE targeted revision to the illustrated athlete on the LEFT: create comfortable framing and closer face/hair likeness. Reduce the entire illustrated figure (including arms and basketball) slightly and place it lower so the complete head and all hair have at least 45px of dark/brush background above them. Keep both elbows, hands and ball inside the canvas with at least 25px from the left edge. The lower thighs may meet the bottom edge naturally. Do not shrink or move the right text block.
Re-draw the face and hair closer to official portrait 2: compact short sandy/light brown hair with a modest side-swept fringe, neatly short sides, no long voluminous flowing locks. Match the portrait's long angular face, squared chin, straight nose, clean-shaven cheeks, thin light eyebrows and light blue eyes; reduce the exaggerated thick eyebrows. Athletic very tall lean build. Preserve the lively low-post pivot holding the orange ball, hand-drawn ink/brush illustration style, plain unmarked black uniform and the black #151A18/lime #CCF43B/ivory palette. NO photograph, no logo, no uniform number, no sponsor marks.

Everything else must remain as in image 1: same landscape roughly 16:9 size at least 1000px wide, right-side text and hierarchy, date, all exact wording and spelling, colors, lower label. The only displayed text is:
バスケまとめ
11/21
試合結果
当日のEFF
B.ONE・B.NEXT

Keep the typography clean and fully inside the frame. Keep fingers anatomically natural. Do not add anyone else or any new text. This is an imagined play illustration and never a reconstruction of an actual game.
